summary: Vendor releases + security incidents lead today: Cloudflare vulnerability and Worker Previews, OpenAI Codex release, Google Gemini GA, plus multiple repo-first infra launches (sandbase, overdeck, couchbase) and HN community MCP/agent workflow threads.
